workflow_runs.display_title: fix(runtime): remove pre-start state after an unmapped project refusal

head_commit.message:
fix(runtime): remove pre-start state after an unmapped project refusal

Package-mode startup records state before descriptor binding. A successful
HXW006 refusal deleted the state file but left the diagnostics directory.
The provisioning lock is released before that empty state directory is removed.
